name: Pale Signal Workshop
description: One of the oldest continuously operating independent studios in GLMZ, Pale Signal Workshop has survived since 2188 by producing flat-screen content for Tier 1-2 distribution — a medium Vantablack's licensing apparatus largely ignores as commercially irrelevant. Their productions are rough, technically limited, and extraordinarily honest about the Gray Zone and Stack life. They operate from a licensed but perpetually underfunded space in Tier 2 Chicago corridor and have never once turned a profit by conventional accounting.
cultural_impact: Maintained a tradition of flat-screen documentary and drama production for the Gray Zone and Stack audiences across four decades, preserving a form of storytelling that neural-feed economics had otherwise made functionally extinct at their tier level.
story_hooks: Pale Signal's founder is dying and has left the studio's entire archive — including footage they never broadcast — to someone who has no idea why
A Tier 4 collector is attempting to acquire Pale Signal's physical media archive for private preservation, and the terms of the offer are making the current staff deeply uneasy
Something in Pale Signal's 2194 footage archive has become relevant to a current corponation dispute in ways that could get everyone involved killed
